scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed — colorblind-safe Tol palette, clear typographic hierarchy, smart bee-swarm + box-plot composition, and leader-line callouts show real intent, but the top-right callout label ('Sam Q. — $500,0…') is clipped at the viewport edge and the subtitle overlaps the P25 percentile label, two concrete layout bugs that floor an 8.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate for income data, box plot quantiles are data-driven, uniform-radius circles carry no size lie factor, and colorblind-safe palette is used — docked one point for hardcoded axis domain [14000,550000] instead of data-driven d3.extent, and absent key functions on data joins.
scores.stress_test_note: No brush, zoom, or cross-view dispatch; simulation is pre-computed synchronously; pointer events API unifies mouse/touch; only interaction is a trivially cheap tooltip reposition on pointermove — no interaction robustness violations.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view with 4 well-separated categorical colors, pre-computed swarm (no live animation), and a shared-axis box plot summary — complexity is well-managed, though the 5 top-earner callout labels cluster tightly in the upper-right and slightly overlap each other.

proposer: Replaced the `.each()` callout pattern with precomputed data + declarative joins (saves ~4 lines), and simplified the tick format by removing a dead branch (all tick values are ≥ 1000).
